_roles_help: Each logical unit belongs to exactly one role. buy = upstream transit you pay for; provide = customers and your own distribution routers; peer = private interconnects (not bought transit); cache = cache/CDN content sources; transport = traffic that only passes between two VLANs; mgmt = management. Any ae unit not listed is reported as unclassified.
_contracts_help: Contracted capacity per upstream unit in Gbps (not stored on the router). null = unknown.
_notes_help: Why each unit is in its role, and how confident the classification is (High/Medium/Low). Shown on the dashboard.
